firstPlayerRule: In the two-player game, whoever most recently built a snowman starts.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After the starting player's turn, their opponent takes a turn.
The solo rules replace multiplayer setup: you take five cards and resolve their actions before the Automa receives the four remaining cards.
